angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 683,873 km at 36.16 pc = 0.25 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 5529: distance 36.156 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.008), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 36.156 +/- 0.289 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 27.6929 +/- 0.0161 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92), 1716.8 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 0.983 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 5529: radius 0.983 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 0.695 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.048) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 683,873 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5318 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 5529: effective temperature 5318 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.039) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 5529: effective temperature 5318 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.039) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.

surfaceGravitySource: log g 4.39 from 2024A&A...683A.125P; the 23 published values span log g -1.7257 to 4.44 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A%26A...683A.125P)
